title: Design of concrete formwork.
officialText:
Design of formwork, including but not limited to forms, shores, and shoring
foundations, shall comply with ACI 318, Section 6.1.5, and the requirements of Sections 3305.3.2.1 through 3305.3.2.8 of this
code.
